fixIssues_other: Fix {{count}} issues before sending this campaign.

footer.noAudience: Add at least one audience before sending.

locked.banner: This campaign is {{status}} and can no longer be edited. Create a new campaign instead.
locked.toast: A campaign in status {{status}} cannot be changed.

prefill.notFound: This campaign could not be found. It may have been deleted.
prefill.failed: Could not load the campaign for editing.

toast.sent: Email campaign created and queued for delivery.
toast.templateApplied: Applied template “{{name}}” — subject and content replaced.

errors.loadTemplate: Could not load that template. Try again.
errors.loadSenders: Could not load your sender addresses.
errors.loadCustomFields: Could not load custom fields — field filters are unavailable until this is fixed.

apiError.fixHighlighted_one: The server rejected {{count}} field — see the highlighted section.
apiError.fixHighlighted_other: The server rejected {{count}} fields — see the highlighted sections.
apiError.noPermission: You don't have permission to send email campaigns for this institute.
apiError.tooLarge: The email content is too large. Trim it or host large images externally.
apiError.serverError: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was sent — please try again in a moment.
apiError.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again — nothing was sent.
apiError.generic: The campaign could not be saved. Please try again.

title.tooLong: Keep the campaign name under 500 characters.

subject.required: Write an email subject — recipients see it in their inbox.
subject.truncatedWarning: Subjects longer than ~78 characters get cut off in most inboxes.

previewText.missingWarning: No preview text — inboxes will show the first line of your content instead.
previewText.truncatedWarning: Preview text longer than ~150 characters gets cut off in most inboxes.

sender.noneConfigured: No sender address is configured. Set one up under Settings → Notifications before sending.
sender.required: Choose which address to send from.
sender.noLongerAvailable: The sender this campaign used is no longer configured — choose another.

expiresAt.invalid: Enter a valid expiry date and time.
expiresAt.mustBeFuture: The expiry time must be in the future.
expiresAt.beforeSend: The expiry time must be after the scheduled send time.

schedule.pickTime: Pick when this campaign should be sent.
schedule.invalidTime: Enter a valid send date and time.
schedule.mustBeFuture: The send time has already passed — pick a future time, or choose “Send now”.
schedule.cronRequired: Enter a cron expression, or pick one of the presets.
schedule.cronInvalid: That isn't a valid schedule. Use 6 fields (sec min hour day month weekday) with “?” in exactly one of day or weekday, e.g. 0 0 9 * * ?.

campaignName.label: Campaign name
campaignName.hint: Internal name to identify this campaign in your dashboard.

subject.label: Email subject
subject.hint: This is what recipients see in their inbox.

previewText.label: Preview text
previewText.hint: Shown next to the subject in the inbox, before the email is opened.
previewText.placeholder: A short teaser for the inbox…

content.title: Email content
content.description: Write the message, or start from a saved template.

template.label: Start from a template
template.hint: Optional. Applying a template replaces the subject, preview text and content below.
template.appliedHint: Template “{{name}}” applied. Edits you make here won't change the saved template.

settings.title: Sender & delivery settings
settings.description: Who the email comes from, and when it goes out.

sender.label: From email
sender.hint: Recipients will see this name and address as the sender.
sender.noneDescription: Add and verify a sender address before sending email campaigns.

priority.label: Priority
priority.hint: Also shown on the in-app system alert.

expiresAt.label: Expires at (optional)
expiresAt.hint: After this time the in-app alert is hidden. Emails already delivered are unaffected.

immediate.label: Send now
immediate.hint: Goes out as soon as you confirm.

recurring.label: Repeat
recurring.cronHint: 6 fields: second minute hour day month weekday — e.g. 0 0 9 * * ? is every day at 9:00 AM.
recurring.note: The campaign keeps sending on this schedule until it is cancelled from the scheduled list.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.hint: Send times are interpreted in this timezone.

preview.emptyDescription: Your email will appear here as you write it.
preview.dialogDescription: This is how the email renders. Actual appearance can differ slightly between email clients.

rail.previewNote: Live preview. Actual appearance may differ slightly by email client.
rail.tipBody: Combine several audiences, exclusions and field filters to target exactly the right people — overlaps are de-duplicated.
